# Feature Specification: Dashboard, district picture, duplicate review and disaster-mode

**Feature Branch**: `pre-main--spec-desk-data`

**Created**: 2026-10-18 (Asia/Dhaka). Generated by Puku CLI Opus 4.8 worker for the pre-main convergence lane. Pre-main convergence desk output, not a human-approved spec.

**Status**: Draft for human skim; specification only. Derives intent from the V2 spec pack (`docs/spec/`), the actual architecture in `src/server/dashboard/`, `src/server/duplicates/`, `src/app/(desk)/officer/map/`, `src/app/(desk)/officer/duplicates/`, `src/app/(desk)/staff/disaster/` and the existing `docs/execution/evidence/` documents.

**Input**: V2 pack D1 FR-019, FR-022, FR-023, FR-024, FR-025, FR-032, FR-036, D2A API-012, API-014, API-015, API-022, D3 SCREEN-011, SCREEN-013, SCREEN-014, SCREEN-015, D6 TASK-018, TASK-030, TASK-051, TASK-052, TASK-064 (counts), BR-014, BR-021, BR-026, OQ-003.

**Owner**: Masnun (dashboard / duplicates / data) for TASK-018, TASK-030, TASK-051, TASK-064; SCREEN-015 disaster mode is a planned extension labelled "পরিকল্পিত". The convergence-desk lane only writes this spec; it does not write the dashboard / duplicates / disaster-mode code.

This feature covers the desk-side aggregates and the duplicate-detector review: SCREEN-011 shows the per-district missing / found / confirmed counts and a map with bundled outlines and a synthetic chip; SCREEN-014 (FR-023) lets an officer mark a duplicate link as same/different; SCREEN-015 (FR-036) shows a "পরিকল্পিত" disaster-mode logging panel; the API-012 dashboard stats and the API-014 duplicate route carry the role-scoped projection and never reveal another party's payload. (STORY-013, STORY-014, STORY-021; SCREEN-011, SCREEN-013, SCREEN-014, SCREEN-015; FR-019, FR-022, FR-023, FR-024, FR-032, FR-036; BR-007, BR-014, BR-021, BR-024, BR-026; TASK-018, TASK-030, TASK-048, TASK-051, TASK-052, TASK-064; TC-012, TC-013, TC-014, TC-021, TC-022, TC-035, TC-044, TC-045, TC-055)

## User Scenarios & Testing *(mandatory)*

Stories 1–4 support V2 Must behaviour; Story 5 is the Could disaster-mode. P1/P2/P3 reflect source priorities from D1/D6; this list does not introduce a new ranking.

### User Story 1 - Per-district missing / found / confirmed counts (Priority: P1)

SCREEN-011 shows separate counts for missing-report rows, found-report rows and confirmed pairs by district, with an accessible icon + text + colour for each. The map uses bundled district outlines; no exact coordinates; every seeded record carries the visible "সিনথেটিক" label. (STORY-013; FR-019, FR-032; BR-014, BR-026; SCREEN-011; API-012; TASK-030)

**Why this priority**: Must requirement (GOAL-006, A-022). Honest counts distinguish three kinds of rows; the map and the table share the same numbers.

**Independent Test**: Seed the manifest, open SCREEN-011, assert the per-district missing / found / confirmed counts match the seeded aggregate, assert the synthetic label is visible, assert exact coordinates are never present. (TC-012, TC-021, TC-055)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** a seeded manifest, **when** the dashboard loads, **then** per-district counts are present for missing, found and confirmed; the icons, text and colour are accessible (WCAG 2.2 AA). (FR-019; BR-014; TC-012)
2. **Given** the map view, **when** it loads, **then** only bundled district outlines and a `সিনথেটিক` chip are shown; no photo, no face, no exact coordinate. (FR-019, FR-032; BR-006, BR-026; TC-012, TC-021)
3. **Given** all 64 districts, **when** the dashboard loads, **then** every district has a row, including districts with zero reported cases. (FR-019; BR-014; API-012; TC-012, TC-055)
4. **Given** the table view, **when** it loads, **then** a staff member sees their own found cases, a verified officer sees candidate counts and confirmed pairs, and an admin sees aggregate counts without candidate IDs. (BR-007, BR-014, BR-024; TC-019, TC-022, TC-044, TC-045)
5. **Given** the drill-through, **when** a district is selected, **then** the officer-only row fetch returns the cases filtered by district, kind and status group with the keyset cursor; an admin has no access. (D2A §9.2; FR-019; BR-014, BR-024; TC-022)

---

### User Story 2 - Duplicate detection and officer review (Priority: P1)

The duplicate detector scans for same-name + same-dob or near-embedding duplicates and emits a "possible duplicate" banner on the match review page. Shared phone alone never suppresses a report. SCREEN-014 (FR-023) lets an officer mark a duplicate link as same / different, with profile evidence, a reason, and preserved original reports. A dismissal is reviewed reversible. (STORY-014; FR-022, FR-023; BR-007, BR-021; SCREEN-014; API-014; TASK-018, TASK-051)

**Why this priority**: Must requirement (GOAL-004). Honest detection without suppression preserves reviewability.

**Independent Test**: Seed two reports that share a phone number and a report that shares a name + dob, run the duplicate detector, assert the shared-phone pair is **not** suppressed and the name+dob pair is flagged. Open SCREEN-014, mark the link as same / different with profile evidence; assert the original reports are unchanged. (TC-013, TC-022)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** two reports that share only a phone number, **when** the duplicate detector runs, **then** no duplicate link is emitted and both reports remain independently discoverable. (FR-022; BR-007, BR-021; TC-013, TC-022)
2. **Given** two reports that share name + dob, **when** the detector runs, **then** a duplicate link is emitted with profile evidence and reason; the original reports stay discoverable until the officer dismisses the link. (FR-022, FR-023; BR-021; TC-013)
3. **Given** a duplicate link, **when** an officer marks it as "same" with profile evidence and a reason, **then** the link is recorded and the original reports are unchanged; the audit log carries the link id, the actor role and the reason only. (FR-023; BR-021; TC-013)
4. **Given** a duplicate link, **when** an officer dismisses it with a reason, **then** the dismissal is audited and the original reports are unchanged. (FR-023; BR-021; TC-013)
5. **Given** a new report with the same name + dob after a dismissal, **when** the detector runs, **then** the new report is independently discoverable and the detector does not auto-re-link the dismissed pair. (FR-023; BR-021; TC-013)

---

### User Story 3 - Synthetic fixture import (Priority: P2)

A redactor admin opens SCREEN-013, sees a dashed "পরিকল্পিত" panel labelled "সিনথেটিক ইমপোর্ট — এখনো তৈরি হয়নি", and the API-015 stub returns 501 / E-019 with no record written. Real public-child import is disabled in V2; only invented fixture texts in public-report format are accepted by the planned import (TASK-048, FR-024). (STORY-015; FR-024; BR-026, FR-024; SCREEN-013; API-015; TASK-048)

**Why this priority**: Should requirement (GOAL-Support). The import is a planned extension; FR-024 accepts invented fixture texts only.

**Independent Test**: Open SCREEN-013, assert the "পরিকল্পিত" panel is visible and the synthetic chip is present; submit, assert 501 / E-019 and no record written. (TC-014, TC-035)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** SCREEN-013, **when** it loads, **then** a dashed "পরিকল্পিত" panel labelled "সিনথেটিক ইমপোর্ট — এখনো তৈরি হয়নি" is visible; the synthetic chip is present. (FR-024; OQ-003; TC-014, TC-035)
2. **Given** a synthetic fixture import submit, **when** the request is made, **then** the API returns 501 / E-019 with no record written and no audit row. (FR-024; OQ-003; TC-014)
3. **Given** any future import, **when** it accepts a record, **then** the record carries an `is_synthetic = true` flag, a `synthetic_label`, and a `source` of "fixture"; real public-child import is disabled. (FR-024; BR-026; D3; OQ-003)

---

### User Story 4 - Admin redaction eligibility, verify-officers, and the synthetic-redaction coupling (Priority: P1)

A redactor admin opens SCREEN-013, sees the eligible count (closed missing + referred found with the missing report also closed), the verify-officers table, and the synthetic import slot. Redaction redacts the eligible pair, writes `case.payload_redacted` per case, and the audit details carry only the mode and the `external_copies_removed` flag. (STORY-016; FR-025, FR-035; BR-009, BR-010, BR-024; SCREEN-013; API-016, API-017; TASK-032)

**Why this priority**: Must requirement (Safeguarding, BR-009). Redaction is the only path that clears direct and related identifying payloads from eligible terminal reports; active linked evidence is kept.

**Independent Test**: Seed 3 closed/referred reports (1 eligible pair, 1 active pair with confirmed but unclosed missing, 1 open) and 1 open; redact `all_eligible: true`; assert 2 redacted, 1 skipped, mode `pseudonymisation`, `external_copies_removed: false`; assert the active pair and the open report keep their payload; assert the referral note and candidate reason are `[REDACTED]` on the eligible pair, untouched on the active pair. (TC-015, TC-050)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** an eligible pair (closed missing + referred found with the missing report also closed), **when** the admin confirms the typed word "বেনামী" and submits, **then** both cases are redacted, both `case.payload_redacted` audit rows are written by the admin, the eligible count becomes 0, and a repeat run gives `{ redacted: 0, skipped_not_eligible: 1 }`. (FR-025; BR-009, BR-010; TC-015)
2. **Given** an active pair (confirmed missing not yet closed), **when** the admin runs redaction, **then** the pair is skipped, the missing and found reports keep their payload, and the audit log records the skip. (FR-025; BR-009; TC-015)
3. **Given** the redaction form, **when** the typed word does not match, **then** the submit is refused (inline error, `aria-invalid`) and no redaction is performed. (FR-025; BR-009, BR-024; TC-015)
4. **Given** a non-admin attempting API-016, **when** the request is made, **then** the request is refused (E-003) and `access.denied` is written. (BR-007, BR-024; TC-022, TC-052)
5. **Given** the redaction rate limit (`adminRedaction` 5/min per principal), **when** the 6th request is made in a minute, **then** the request is refused (E-007) and the response fails closed. (OD-032-4)

---

### User Story 5 - Disaster-mode logging screen (Priority: P3)

A disaster-mode logging screen (SCREEN-015) is a planned extension labelled "পরিকল্পিত" in the UI; the API is a stub that returns 501 with `E-019` and writes no record. (STORY-021; FR-036; OQ-003; SCREEN-015; TASK-052; TC-035)

**Why this priority**: Could in D6. The screen is labelled but not implemented in this lane unless the mentor table names it.

**Independent Test**: Open SCREEN-015, assert the planned label is visible, submit a form, assert 501 and no record written. (TC-035; OD-052-1)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** SCREEN-015, **when** it loads, **then** the planned label is visible and no form is submittable to a live endpoint. (FR-036; OQ-003; TC-035)
2. **Given** a submit, **when** the request is made, **then** the API returns 501 and writes nothing. (FR-036; TC-035)

---

### Edge Cases

- A district with no reported cases still appears with zeros (API-012 "all 64 district rows including zeros"). (FR-019; BR-014; TC-012, TC-055)
- A duplicate link is dismissed while a new report with the same name + dob is created: the dismissal is preserved, the new report is independently discoverable, and the detector does not auto-re-link. (FR-023; BR-021)
- A redaction rate-limit hit (E-007) leaves the form usable; the user can retry after the rate-limit window. (OD-032-4)
- An admin attempts API-022 (drill-through) — the API is officer-only (D2A §9.2); a request returns E-003 and writes `access.denied`. (BR-007, BR-024; TC-022)
- A disaster-mode submit produces no record and no audit row; the UI shows the planned label and a submittable form returns 501 / E-019. (FR-036; OQ-003; TC-035)
- A district drill-through row fetch returns the cases filtered by district, kind and status group with the keyset cursor; a forged cursor is E-001. (BR-024; TC-022)

## Requirements *(mandatory)*

### Scope and boundaries

Feature 006 owns the desk-side aggregates and the duplicate-detector review work mapped to TASK-018, TASK-030, TASK-048, TASK-051, TASK-052 and the SCREEN-013 synthetic-import slot. It consumes behaviour built in features 001–005 and changes none of their requirements. Fixes found here go to the matching-data owner under AGENTS ownership. Every record is invented and synthetic; no real child, photo, face, alert, physical return, police or CID integration, or legal-compliance claim is in scope. (BR-002, BR-006, BR-026)

### Functional Requirements

- **TASK-018; FR-022; BR-007, BR-021**: The duplicate detector emits links on `same_name_dob` and `near_embedding`, never on shared phone alone, and the original reports stay discoverable. (TC-013, TC-022)
- **TASK-030; FR-019, FR-032; BR-014, BR-026**: SCREEN-011 + API-012 show per-district missing / found / confirmed counts with accessible icon + text + colour, a synthetic chip, and a map with bundled outlines and no exact coordinates. All 64 districts are returned, including zeros. (TC-012, TC-021, TC-055)
- **TASK-030 (drill-through); D2A §9.2; FR-019; BR-014, BR-024**: API-022 returns the cases filtered by district, kind and status group with the keyset cursor; officer-only; an admin has no access; a forged HMAC cursor is E-001. (TC-022)
- **TASK-051; FR-023; BR-007, BR-021**: SCREEN-014 + API-014 let an officer mark a duplicate link as same/different with profile evidence and a reason; the original reports stay discoverable. (TC-013)
- **TASK-048; FR-024; BR-026**: Synthetic fixture import is a planned extension; the panel is labelled "পরিকল্পিত"; the API returns 501 / E-019; real public-child import is disabled. (TC-014, TC-035)
- **TASK-052; FR-036; OQ-003**: SCREEN-015 shows a "পরিকল্পিত" panel and the API returns 501 / E-019 with no record written. (TC-035)
- **TASK-032; FR-025; BR-009, BR-010, BR-024**: SCREEN-013 admin redaction: the typed-confirmation word "বেনামী" must match exactly (NFC + trim); the eligible-count is shared with the API; an active pair and an open report are never redacted; the rate limit is 5/min per principal and fails closed. (TC-015, TC-022, TC-050, TC-052; OD-032-4)

### Key Entities

- **District (64 rows)**: `code (1–64)`, `name_en`, `name_bn`, `division_en`, 2-decimal lat/lng centroid, `neighbours (codes)`. (TASK-009; ENTITY-010, ENTITY-011; BR-014)
- **District stats row**: `code, name_bn, name_en, lat, lng, missing_open, missing_matched, missing_closed, found_open, found_matched, found_referred, confirmed_pairs`. Districts with no reported cases still appear with zeros. (TASK-030; FR-019; BR-014; TC-012, TC-055)
- **District drill-through row (officer-only)**: `id, kind, status_group, district_code, name_bn (truncated/redacted per role), created_at, last_action_at`. (D2A §9.2; FR-019; BR-007, BR-014, BR-024; TC-022)
- **Duplicate link**: `id, left_case_id, right_case_id, kind (same_name_dob|near_embedding), evidence, decided_at?, decided_by?, decision (same|different)?, reason?, dismissed_at?, dismissed_by?`. (TASK-018, TASK-051; FR-022, FR-023; BR-021)
- **Synthetic fixture import slot (planned)**: API-015 stub returns 501 / E-019 with no record written. (TASK-048; FR-024; BR-026; TC-014)
- **Disaster-mode stub**: API-016 disaster-mode stub returns 501 / E-019 with no record written. (TASK-052; FR-036; OQ-003; TC-035)
- **Redaction eligibility**: closed missing + referred found with the missing report also closed; pseudonymisation, not legal anonymisation. (TASK-032; FR-025; BR-009; TC-015, TC-050)

## Success Criteria *(mandatory)*

### Measurable Outcomes

These are acceptance targets for the desk-side aggregates, duplicate review, synthetic import and disaster-mode. None is an achieved result at specification time.

- **SC-001**: SCREEN-011 shows per-district missing / found / confirmed counts that match the seeded aggregate; every count is icon + text + colour; the synthetic chip is visible. (TASK-030; FR-019, FR-032; BR-014, BR-026; TC-012)
- **SC-002**: All 64 districts appear, including those with zero reported cases. (TASK-030; FR-019; BR-014; TC-012, TC-055)
- **SC-003**: A duplicate detector run on a shared-phone pair emits 0 links and on a same-name + same-dob pair emits ≥1 link with profile evidence and reason. (TASK-018, TASK-051; FR-022; BR-007, BR-021; TC-013)
- **SC-004**: An officer mark on SCREEN-014 (same / different) records the link decision and audit, and preserves the original reports. (TASK-051; FR-023; BR-021; TC-013)
- **SC-005**: SCREEN-013 shows the "পরিকল্পিত" synthetic-import panel and the SCREEN-015 disaster-mode panel; the APIs return 501 / E-019 with no record written. (TASK-048, TASK-052; FR-024, FR-036; OQ-003; TC-014, TC-035)
- **SC-006**: A redaction of an eligible pair redacts both cases, writes two `case.payload_redacted` audit rows, sets `anonymised_at`, and never touches an active pair or an open report. (TASK-032; FR-025; BR-009; TC-015, TC-050)
- **SC-007**: A non-admin attempting API-016 is refused (E-003) and writes `access.denied`; the rate limit `adminRedaction` 5/min is enforced. (TASK-032; FR-037; BR-007, BR-024; TC-022, TC-052; OD-032-4)
